title: Crew Lottery
summary: Sector review: the sampling distribution of a proportion. How much does the share of women wander in random crews of 50 and 200?
hints: `women <- first$sex == "female"` is TRUE/FALSE per astronaut, and `mean(women)` is the proportion.
One crew of 50: `mean(sample(women, size = 50, replace = TRUE))`. Wrap it in `replicate(2000, ...)`.
`se_50 <- sd(props_50)`, `se_200 <- sd(props_200)`, then `se_50 / se_200`. Four times the crew should roughly halve the SE.
